I checked again, John, and Shop···· still hasn't shipped. Your Magic Miner 40T is waiting on stock at our US warehouse, and the units haven't reached us yet.

You've had the same answer from me several times now, and that isn't good enough. So I've asked the team for a real update: whether the units have left the factory and when they'll land in the US. They're offline until Monday at 10am ET, and the answer will come to (email hidden)

You'll also get tracking by email as soon as your miner ships.
